rv.q: Full of questions and wonder, After the Blast is a play of the moment, and a performance one should not miss.
After the Blast is a wonderful exploration both of depression and of how far someone can or should go to help a loved one going through it.
Director JD Caudill and Assistant Director Allison Petrillo do a phenomenal job of interpreting this timely story.

cn.t: Broken Nose Theatre's production of Kazan's post-apocalyptic drama earns strong praise for tackling timely questions about AI, connection, and survival with charm and emotional depth in an intimate, well-executed staging.
